newsitem.title: USA: Carolina First made bid for Peoples Bank.
newsitem.headline: Carolina First made bid for Peoples Bank.

text.p: Carolina First BancShares Inc on Monday identified itself as the rejected suitor of Peoples Bank.
Carolina First said it had offered to acquire Peoples Bank for $31 per share in a deal worth $52.75 million.
Last week, Peoples Bank said it had received and rejected a takeover offer but did not name the suitor.
Carolina First said it was issuing its statement today in response to the Peoples Bank statement.
Peoples Bank said it had unanimously rejected a takeover offer because the bid "did not adequately recognize Peoples Bank's exciting future prospects."
It did not disclose details of the bid.
